found`);if(j.content_model_version!=='staged_v1')throw new Error(`Unsupported content model: ${j.content_model_version}`);if(j.status!=='processing'||j.current_stage!=='voiceover')throw new Error(`Job ${j.job_id} is not eligible for inventory execution: ${j.status}/${j.current_stage}`);if(!clean(j.voiceover_path)||!Number.isFinite(Number(j.voiceover_duration_seconds))||Number(j.voiceover_duration_seconds)<=0)throw new Error('Accepted continuous voiceover is missing');const story=j.story_package;if(!story||story.version!=='inventory-first-story-v1'||!Array.isArray(story.units)||story.units.length<2||story.units.length>12||!Array.isArray(story.assets)||story.assets.length!==story.units.length)throw new Error('Inventory-first story package is missing');if(!Array.isArray(j.scenes)||j.scenes.length!==story.units.length)throw new Error(`Timed story unit count ${j.scenes?.length??0}/${story.units.length}`);if(Number(j.existing_visual_segment_count??0)!==0||Number(j.existing_visual_shot_count??0)!==0)throw new Error('Job already has visual execution state');const assets=new Map(story.assets.map(a=>[clean(a?.asset_id),a]));if(assets.size!==story.assets.length)throw new Error('Reserved story assets are not unique');let previous=0;for(let i=0;i<story.units.length;i++){const u=story.units[i]??{},s=j.scenes[i]??{},aid=clean(u.asset_id),a=assets.get(aid),start=Number(s.beat_start_seconds),end=Number(s.beat_end_seconds),dur=Number(s.duration_seconds);if(clean(u.unit_id)!==`U${i+1}`||Number(s.scene_number)!==i+1||clean(s.narration)!==clean(u.narration)||!a||!clean(a.download_url)||!clean(a.provider)||!clean(a.provider_asset_id)||!/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(clean(a.visual_hash).toLowerCase()))throw new Error(`Story unit ${i+1} lost reserved asset/timing identity`);if(!Number.isFinite(start)||!Number.isFinite(end)||!Number.isFinite(dur)||Math.abs(start-previous)>0.002||Math.abs((end-start)-dur)>0.012)throw new Error(`Story unit ${i+1} timing is invalid`);previous=end;}if(Math.abs(previous-Number(j.voiceover_duration_seconds))>0.01)throw new Error('Story units do not cover accepted voiceover');return [{json:{...j,story_unit_count:story.units.length}}];

WITH u AS (
 UPDATE public.jobs j SET current_stage='visuals',last_error=NULL,updated_at=now()
 WHERE j.id=$1::uuid AND j.content_model_version='staged_v1' AND j.status='processing' AND j.current_stage='voiceover'
   AND j.story_package->>'version'='inventory-first-story-v1'
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.visual_segments vs WHERE vs.job_id=j.id)
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.visual_shots sh WHERE sh.job_id=j.id)
 RETURNING j.id
)
SELECT $1::uuid AS job_id,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM u) AS ready_to_run;

parameters.jsCode: const transition=$input.first().json,j=$('Require Eligible Visual Job').first().json,clean=v=>String(v??'').normalize('NFKC').replace(/\s+/gu,' ').trim();if(transition.ready_to_run!==true)throw new Error(`Job ${j.job_id} could not enter visuals stage`);const story=j.story_package,assets=new Map(story.assets.map(a=>[clean(a.asset_id),a])),out=[];for(let i=0;i<story.units.length;i++){const u=story.units[i],s=j.scenes[i],a=assets.get(clean(u.asset_id));if(!a)throw new Error(`Reserved asset missing for story unit ${i+1}`);const evidence=[...new Set((Array.isArray(u.evidence_ids)?u.evidence_ids:[]).map(clean).filter(Boolean))];out.push({json:{job_id:j.job_id,story_unit_count:story.units.length,unit_number:i+1,unit_id:clean(u.unit_id),claim_id:clean(u.claim_id),scene_id:clean(s.scene_id),start_seconds:Number(s.beat_start_seconds),end_seconds:Number(s.beat_end_seconds),duration_seconds:Number(s.duration_seconds),narration:clean(u.narration),support_evidence_ids:evidence,canonical_subject:clean(j.fact_primary_title||j.topic),visual_target:clean(u.visual_target),visible_description:clean(u.visible_description),provider:clean(a.provider).toLowerCase(),provider_asset_id:clean(a.provider_asset_id),candidate_id:clean(a.candidate_id),source_url:clean(a.source_url)||null,download_url:clean(a.download_url),author:clean(a.author)||null,license:clean(a.license)||null,license_url:clean(a.license_url)||null,source_media_kind:clean(a.media_kind||'photo').toLowerCase(),reserved_visual_hash:clean(a.visual_hash).toLowerCase(),reserved_visual_cluster_key:clean(a.visual_cluster_key),reserved_metadata:a.metadata??{}}});}return out;

parameters.jsCode: const stored=$json,reserved=$('Expand Reserved Story Assets').item.json,path=String(stored.visual_path??'').trim(),media=String(stored.media_type??'').trim(),w=Number(stored.width),h=Number(stored.height),bytes=Number(stored.bytes);if(!path||!['image','video'].includes(media)||!Number.isFinite(w)||w<=0||!Number.isFinite(h)||h<=0||!Number.isFinite(bytes)||bytes<=0)throw new Error(`Reserved asset ${reserved.provider}:${reserved.provider_asset_id} returned invalid stored visual`);return {json:{...reserved,visual_path:path,stored_media_type:media,stored_width:w,stored_height:h,stored_bytes:bytes,stored_duration_seconds:Number(stored.duration_seconds??0)||null}};

const fp=$json,reserved=$('Validate Stored Reserved Visual').item.json,actual=String(fp.visual_hash??'').trim().toLowerCase(),expected=String(reserved.reserved_visual_hash??'').trim().toLowerCase();if(!/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(actual)||!/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(expected))throw new Error(`Reserved asset ${reserved.provider}:${reserved.provider_asset_id} has invalid fingerprint`);const bit=[0,1,1,2,1,2,2,3,1,2,2,3,2,3,3,4];let distance=0;for(let i=0;i<64;i++)distance+=bit[parseInt(actual[i],16)^parseInt(expected[i],16)];if(distance>18)throw new Error(`Stored asset identity diverged from reviewed preview: hamming=${distance}`);const visualKind=reserved.stored_media_type==='video'?'context_video':(['diagram','animation','illustration','schematic'].includes(reserved.source_media_kind)?'factual_graphic':'factual_image');return {json:{...reserved,actual_visual_hash:actual,preview_to_stored_hamming:distance,visual_cluster_key:`stored:${actual}`,visual_kind:visualKind}};

WITH segment AS (
 INSERT INTO public.visual_segments(job_id,segment_number,first_scene_number,last_scene_number,start_seconds,end_seconds,duration_seconds,narration,support_evidence_ids,canonical_subject,visual_target,visual_lane,visual_query,visual_description,planned_shot_count,status)
 VALUES($1::uuid,$2::int,$2::int,$2::int,$3::numeric,$4::numeric,($4::numeric-$3::numeric),$5::text,$6::jsonb,$7::text,$8::text,'reference',$8::text,$9::text,1,'ready')
 ON CONFLICT(job_id,segment_number) DO NOTHING RETURNING id
), library AS (
 INSERT INTO public.media_library_assets(provider,provider_asset_id,source_url,author,license,license_url,local_path,media_kind,visual_hash,canonical_subject,metadata,last_used_at)
 SELECT $10::text,$11::text,NULLIF($12::text,''),NULLIF($13::text,''),NULLIF($14::text,''),NULLIF($15::text,''),$16::text,$17::text,$18::text,$7::text,$19::jsonb,now() FROM segment
 ON CONFLICT(provider,provider_asset_id) DO UPDATE SET last_used_at=now(),metadata=public.media_library_assets.metadata||EXCLUDED.metadata
 RETURNING id
), shot AS (
 INSERT INTO public.visual_shots(job_id,visual_segment_id,shot_number,segment_shot_number,start_seconds,end_seconds,duration_seconds,media_library_asset_id,local_path,visual_cluster_key,visual_kind,selection_score,metadata)
 SELECT $1::uuid,segment.id,$2::int,1,$3::numeric,$4::numeric,($4::numeric-$3::numeric),library.id,$16::text,$20::text,$21::text,1.0,$19::jsonb FROM segment CROSS JOIN library
 RETURNING id
)
SELECT $1::uuid AS job_id,$2::int AS unit_number,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM segment) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shot) AS persisted;

parameters.jsCode: const rows=$input.all().map(x=>x.json),expected=$('Expand Reserved Story Assets').all().length;if(!expected||rows.length!==expected)throw new Error(`Reserved visual persistence cardinality ${rows.length}/${expected}`);const ids=new Set();for(const r of rows){if(r.persisted!==true)throw new Error(`Reserved visual unit ${r.unit_number} was not persisted`);ids.add(Number(r.unit_number));}if(ids.size!==expected||[...ids].sort((a,b)=>a-b).some((n,i)=>n!==i+1))throw new Error('Reserved visual persistence unit set is incomplete');return [{json:{job_id:rows[0].job_id,story_unit_count:expected}}];

WITH j AS (SELECT id,status,current_stage,voiceover_duration_seconds,story_package FROM public.jobs WHERE id=$1::uuid AND content_model_version='staged_v1'),
segments AS (SELECT vs.*,lag(vs.end_seconds) OVER(ORDER BY vs.segment_number) previous_end,row_number() OVER(ORDER BY vs.segment_number)::int rn FROM public.visual_segments vs WHERE vs.job_id=$1::uuid),
shots AS (SELECT sh.*,lag(sh.end_seconds) OVER(ORDER BY sh.shot_number) previous_end,row_number() OVER(ORDER BY sh.shot_number)::int rn FROM public.visual_shots sh WHERE sh.job_id=$1::uuid),
q AS (
 SELECT jsonb_array_length(j.story_package->'units')::int expected_count,
   (SELECT count(*)::int FROM segments) segment_count,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM shots) shot_count,
   (SELECT count(DISTINCT media_library_asset_id)::int FROM shots) unique_asset_count,(SELECT count(DISTINCT visual_cluster_key)::int FROM shots) unique_cluster_count,
   (SELECT count(*)::int FROM segments WHERE segment_number<>rn OR abs(start_seconds-COALESCE(previous_end,0))>0.02 OR abs((end_seconds-start_seconds)-duration_seconds)>0.02 OR status<>'ready') bad_segment_count,
   (SELECT count(*)::int FROM shots WHERE shot_number<>rn OR abs(start_seconds-COALESCE(previous_end,0))>0.02 OR abs((end_seconds-start_seconds)-duration_seconds)>0.02) bad_shot_count,
   COALESCE((SELECT max(end_seconds) FROM shots),0)::numeric final_end
 FROM j
), persisted AS (
 UPDATE public.jobs x SET visual_quality=jsonb_build_object('version','inventory-first-story-v1','story_unit_count',q.expected_count,'segment_count',q.segment_count,'shot_count',q.shot_count,'unique_asset_count',q.unique_asset_count,'unique_visual_cluster_count',q.unique_cluster_count,'reserved_before_script',true,'post_freeze_search_used',false,'pass',(q.expected_count>0 AND q.segment_count=q.expected_count AND q.shot_count=q.expected_count AND q.unique_asset_count=q.expected_count AND q.unique_cluster_count=q.expected_count AND q.bad_segment_count=0 AND q.bad_shot_count=0 AND abs(q.final_end-j.voiceover_duration_seconds)<=0.02)),updated_at=now()
 FROM j,q WHERE x.id=j.id RETURNING x.visual_quality
)
SELECT $1::uuid AS job_id,j.status,j.current_stage,q.*,(SELECT visual_quality FROM persisted LIMIT 1) visual_quality,
 (j.status='processing' AND j.current_stage='visuals' AND q.expected_count>0 AND q.segment_count=q.expected_count AND q.shot_count=q.expected_count AND q.unique_asset_count=q.expected_count AND q.unique_cluster_count=q.expected_count AND q.bad_segment_count=0 AND q.bad_shot_count=0 AND abs(q.final_end-j.voiceover_duration_seconds)<=0.02) all_visuals_ready
FROM j CROSS JOIN q;

parameters.jsCode: const r=$json;if(r.all_visuals_ready!==true)throw new Error(`Reserved visual completion failed: segments=${r.segment_count}/${r.expected_count}, shots=${r.shot_count}/${r.expected_count}, assets=${r.unique_asset_count}/${r.expected_count}, clusters=${r.unique_cluster_count}/${r.expected_count}, bad_segments=${r.bad_segment_count}, bad_shots=${r.bad_shot_count}`);if(!r.visual_quality||r.visual_quality.version!=='inventory-first-story-v1'||r.visual_quality.reserved_before_script!==true||r.visual_quality.post_freeze_search_used!==false||r.visual_quality.pass!==true)throw new Error('Durable inventory-first visual quality was not persisted');return [{json:{job_id:r.job_id,visuals_ready:true,visual_quality:r.visual_quality}}];

const received=$('Receive Job ID').first().json??{};const normalize=v=>String(v??'').trim().toLowerCase();const jobId=normalize(received.job_id||$json.job_id||$json.requested_job_id);if(!/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/.test(jobId))throw new Error('Visual failure handler could not recover job_id');const vals=[$json.details?.description,$json.error?.message,$json.error?.description,typeof $json.error==='string'?$json.error:null,$json.message,$json.errorMessage];const message=String(vals.find(v=>typeof v==='string'&&v.trim())||'Visual stage failed').replace(/\s+/gu,' ').trim().slice(0,4000);return {json:{job_id:jobId,last_error:message}};

parameters.query: UPDATE public.jobs SET status='failed',current_stage='visuals',last_error=$2::text,updated_at=now() WHERE id=$1::uuid RETURNING id AS job_id,status,current_stage,last_error;
